text: Westport Albion regain possession deep in their own half as Marek Zielinski intercepts the ball near the left side. They patiently move upfield with quick short passes along the central corridor, covering about 40 metres towards Kingsmoor FC’s goal at the far end. Dylan Rahman advances down the right flank and delivers a precise cross into the penalty area. Rafael Delacroix, positioned centrally just 2 metres from goal, meets the ball with a swift shot and scores, leveling the match at 2-2.
